title: Telegram Channel Scraper & Monitor - Public Posts
description: Scrape public Telegram channels: full message history, views, reactions, forwards, replies, polls, links and media metadata. Date-range backfill, keyword/regex filters and incremental monitoring for scheduled runs. No login, no API key.
